ns2:section.sectionText: Experienced mentors will guide student teams in creating original motion/media + computer technology projects and in using them to affect social change. Classes will be held at various campus centers of innovation, and students will make field trips to local community destinations. For performing artists, visual and media artists, computer engineers, writers, designers and social scientists. But students in all majors are invited to register. NO PREREQUISITE FOR THIS COURSE OTHER THAN JUNIOR STANDING
